declarations.coverage: This declaration changes only remote GitHub configuration through its authored fixes and checks optional repository-owned reviewer data without writing it, so its project-content scope is intentionally empty. The only remote is origin, https://github.com/lutzseverino/hemiciclo.git, an unambiguous public github.com repository on which the authenticated account lutzseverino holds admin permission; the maintainer requested this update, which authorizes the remote configuration fixes. The reviewer file `.github/pull-request-reviewer.json` is deliberately not part of this run; the maintainer adds it in a separate change.

Hemiciclo is in planning and holds no application code: no manifests, workspace or build configuration, maintained source, or component boundaries. The only code is installed standards tooling (`scripts/`, `operations/lib/`, `vendor/`, `.github/scripts/`), which is exact-owned content, not a Project under `guidance/project-readmes.md`. The scope is intentionally empty. The planned pnpm workspace (apps/web, packages/design, packages/ui, services/hemiciclo, deploy) does not exist yet and is not proposed.
